assets.scope: Standee batch 4 (6 optional final ids: 3 Trollmire trolls, the Chronolith pair, onilug). Second artwork used only for the upright standee layer at <=48px / ~1.0-cell cells. Identity evidence: the shipped native sprite and the shipped flat token, both pinned below; the game was not launched for this round. The flat 128px token, its master and the manifest mapping are untouched. These creatures are only about 1.016-1.0625 cells tall, so the figure must FILL its height and stay stocky: body width:height about 1:1 to 1:1.3, and the whole art about 1.4 times as tall as wide so it still passes the standee upright-aspect gate; do not thin the creature out to look taller.
assets.gate_reason: The shipped flat 128px cut-out is a near-square top-down token; at the 1.0-cell standee width cap it renders about one cell tall, reading as the flat token rather than an upright standee. A full-body upright standee is required for the standee layer only; the flat token, its master and the manifest mapping are unchanged.
assets.desc: A six-armed creature, dressed in robes, with black insectile eyes.

references.note: The shipped flat Chronolith Twin token: copy its matte painted miniature finish, colours, value structure and identity. Ignore its top-down camera and its physical disc entirely - the standee has no disc.

Native Chronolith Twin sprite: identity cue only. Keep the same species, colour pattern, markings, limbs and held items, converted to a true upright standing composition; it is not a pose or proportion specification.

Its pair, Chronolith Clone, must stay clearly distinct: the Twin wears a long split floor-length robe and spreads its six arms in three vertical tiers, while the Clone wears a short robe with the bare blue legs showing and folds its six elbows tight against the body.

assets.render_evidence_note: No fixture run. Identity-render evidence is the pinned native sprite PNG and the shipped flat token PNG; the desc line in the pinned native NPC source is the appearance authority.

prompt_fields.subject: Chronolith Twin: a six-armed robed temporal horror, matching the shipped flat token: a slim blue-grey-skinned figure whose head has flat BLACK INSECTILE EYES, wearing a long pale cream-ivory robe that splits into two long panels down to the ground; all SIX arms are visible and arranged in THREE vertical tiers spread outward (a top pair raised, a middle pair out to the sides, a lower pair lower and forward), the bare blue forearms and hands showing. Match the token's blue limbs and pale robe.
prompt_fields.contrast: Differs from Chronolith Clone by MORE than colour: a LONG split floor-length robe and six arms spread outward in three clear vertical tiers give a tall wide-tiered silhouette; the Clone has a SHORT robe with the bare blue legs showing and the elbows folded tight against the body. The top pair of arms is raised high and adds height, while the robe and the middle arms stay narrow, so the silhouette is about 1.5 to 1.7 times as tall as its widest point and each of the six arms reads as a separate limb. Light orbs, if any, are above the body and are NOT body. No glow, no aura, no particles, no scene.
prompt_fields.composition: Full body, standing upright, the long split robe flaring to the ground at the bottom of the frame, the small insect-eyed blue head at the top, and the six arms in three separate tiers: the top pair REACHING UP high above the head, the middle pair reaching out only a little to the sides with the claws kept in close (the total width is the robe and torso, NOT the arm span), the lower pair forward and down close to the robe. The whole silhouette is clearly taller than wide, about 1.5 to 1.7 times as tall as its widest point; the raised top arms are body and add height. Nothing else above them.
prompt_fields.palette: medium blue-grey skin with darker blue shadow, a pale cream-ivory robe with grey-blue shading in the folds, flat glossy black insect eyes.
